name: Export modal configures PNG, GIF, Sprite Sheet, and Project formats
description: Verify opening the export dialog, switching between PNG, GIF, Sprite Sheet, and Project export tabs, and inspecting settings.

planSteps.description: Click the Export button in the top header
Verify the Export Studio Assets modal opens showing format tabs for PNG, GIF, Sprite Sheet, and .pixibun
Click the Sprite Sheet format tab
Verify the Layout Packing options for Horizontal, Vertical, and Grid and Godot/Unity JSON toggle are displayed
Verify the scale resolution buttons 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x and FPS info are displayed
Verify the export modal is dismissed
